item.title: Magnitude 6.8 earthquake strikes northern Chile, no tsunami threat
item.description: SANTIAGO, Chile (AP) — A magnitude 6.8 earthquake shook northern Chile on Tuesday, swaying buildings in Antofagasta, but authorities said there was no tsunami threat and no immediate reports of damage.

item.title: Lunar probe launched by Japan to study polar ice
item.description: JAXA launched a robotic lander that will search for water ice near the moon's south pole.
